broadcasts: OUT-RIDER OUTPOST: “Hesketh here. Shells, cells, a medic, rumours, and we buy fuel cells. Our power is failing, if you come across anything that holds a charge.”
BOOM-TOWN AUTOMATED GREETER: “Welcome to Boom-Town, where opportunity is mandatory! Entry requires a 100-credit visitor pass.”
STATIC, then a jingle: “DYNAMO-FIZZ! Feel the buzz!” It comes from the direction of the Anomalous Structure.
broadcasts_sometimes: A slow voice, a long way down: “Come and see me, little one. Bring something sweet.” Mother Long-Legs, people say.
WEATHER, read by a machine that has not looked outside in three hundred years: “Fine. Fine. Fine.”
programmes: An advertisement for a kettle. The kettle company outlived the country by a week.
A cookery programme. The host is a Custodian. Nothing is cooked; the counter is very clean.
KAVEROS QUARTERLY RESULTS. A line goes up for eleven minutes and then the tape ends.
A western. Somebody has recorded a sales meeting over the last reel.
Test card. A girl, a clown, a noughts-and-crosses board. You watch it for longer than you meant to.

words.trophy_text:
What was worth a shelf: %s.

Data crystals and Employees of the Century go in here when you bring them home alive.
words.rack_text:
In your hands when you take the lift: %s  (%s hands).
Worn: %s.

Also on the rack: %s.

You set out with what you came home with, unless you choose again here. Choose no gun and you take the handgun. Two hands, unless you wear a sling; the pack holds what you find, and a bigger pack holds more.
words.rack_full: Your hands are full. Leave one first, or wear a sling.
words.outfitter_text:
You have %d cr banked.

A bigger pack brings more home. A sling holds a third gun.
words.outfitter_done: %s: in the armoury, to wear when you leave.
words.armor_text: A vest, good for %d. You put it on when you take the lift.
words.armor_bare: Bare. Come home wearing armour and what is left of it hangs here; you set out in the best you have brought back.
words.locker_text: Shells and cells, in the boxes they were issued in. When you take the lift, every weapon that goes with you is filled to half a load from here.
words.medic_text:
An old wall unit that still knows what a person is supposed to look like. It runs on gauze, glue and dose cartridges.

You are in acceptable condition. You always leave here whole.
words.bed_say: You sleep. Nothing comes through the door.
words.security_text:
CAM 1  the hatch: sand, and the wind moving it.
CAM 2  the road: nothing on it.
CAM 3  the horizon: the Anomalous Structure, with its screens lit.

The near-area map is not wired to this desk yet. For now the lift goes straight to an installation.
words.ledger_text:
Banked  %d cr        Expeditions home  %d        Best haul  %d cr

Brought home: %s.

Furnishings waiting to be put down: %d.  (B, anywhere in the bunker.)
words.ledger_retire: Retire (hand the bunker on to the next scavenger)
words.retire_text:
An old pension terminal somebody rewired to print one line: YOUR SERVICE IS APPRECIATED.

Retiring hands the bunker on. The credits, the weapons, the trophies, the furniture and the robot stay here for whoever comes next. You do not. It cannot be undone.
words.catalogue_text:
Banked: %d cr.   Waiting to be put down: %d.
What you order arrives at once, which is the only thing the old world still does on time. Put it down with B.
words.cradle_empty_text: Empty. He is about the place somewhere, seeing to the floors. Talk to him; he has opinions.
words.cradle_title: A Custodian, dead in the clamps
words.cradle_not_ready: Bring those home and it can be put right.
words.repaired_say: The Custodian's eye comes on. It looks at the floor first, and then at you.
words.lift_text:
What you chose at the rack goes with you, with the vest on the stand, and the locker fills you up. What you carry back alive is banked here; what you are carrying when you die is somebody else's salvage.

The near-area map is not built yet: for now the lift goes straight to the door of an installation.
words.lift_which_way: More than one way in. Which?
words.decor_none: Nothing to put down yet. Order furnishings from the ledger on the desk in the den.

words.cradle_text:
Kaveros pattern, three hundred years off shift. The frame is sound. The logic boards are slag and there is nothing in it that holds a charge.

It needs:
   %s%s
